simple.summary: יָפֵחַ (yâphêach) means properly, puffing , i.e. (figuratively) meditating First listed occurrence: Ps 27 12.

definitions.full: H3307. yapheach [ יָפֵחַ ] adjective breathing or puffing out , construct חָמָס וִיפֵחַ Psa 27:12 puffing out violence (compare Che). יַפְלֵט see below פלט . יְפֻנֶּה see below פנה .
